sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dwijendra Prasad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the applicant is present.
In compliance of the order of this Court dated 29.8.2023, the parties are said to have appeared before the trial court and got their compromise-deed verified.

Certified copies of the compromise-deed and the certified copy of the verification order passed thereon have been placed before the Court, whereby the parties have arrived at compromise and according to the victim, as the wrong identification, the police has made the applicant-Gaurav @ Jay Singh s/o Rajveer, R/o Village-Rampatti Son, P.S.-Magorra, District-Mathura, as an accused in the case while he was not a person, who has committed offence with her.
As per the statement of the victim, the applicant named in the FIR is not the person, who has been chargesheeted by the police.
The person chargesheeted, namely, Gaurav is not a real culprit, hence, the victim does not want to press her case against the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The compromise to this effect between the parties has been verified by the trial court.
The compromise between the parties would not affect the society adversely.

The certified copy of the compromise-deed dated 26.10.2023 and the certified copy of the verification order passed thereon dated 26.10.2023 are before the Court, as the victim is not pressing her accusation against the applicant, hence the compromise between the parties is accepted.
The certified copy of the compromise-deed and the certified copy of the verification order passed thereon shall form part of the order.
This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is decided in terms of the compromise.

Hence, the entire criminal proceedings as well as impugned cognizance order dated 1.5.2019 and charge-sheet dated 5.4.2019 in Case No.6936 of 2020 (State vs. Satendra Bhati) arising out of Case Crime No.1538 of 2018 under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC, P.S.-Highway, District-Mathura, pending in the court of CJM, Mathura, are hereby quashed against the applicant on the basis of compromise between the parties.
